BiblicalUsage: Within — inside. Jesus says the kingdom of God is within you in Luke 17:21, and He tells the Pharisees to cleanse first that which is within the cup, that the outside may be clean also, in Matthew 23:26.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the kingdom is not a place on a map but a reign inside me, and the cleaning God wants starts within, not without.
